films.desc_en: A sleek automotive commercial showing a generic electric vehicle charging seamlessly at a premium highway station in the Macedonian mountains.
films.music: Uplifting electronic ambient synth beat, driving rhythm, 110 bpm
vo_mk: Време за краток одмор и кафе.

shots.kf: Cinematic wide shot of a sleek generic silver electric vehicle driving along a winding mountain road in Mavrovo, North Macedonia. Surrounded by lush green pine trees under a clear blue sky. Soft golden hour sunlight. Photorealistic, anamorphic lens, highly detailed, premium automotive aesthetic, no logos, no text.
shots.motion: The silver car drives smoothly forward along the curved road while the camera slowly tracks alongside it.

shots.kf: Close-up of a sleek, minimalist, matte-black EV charging station with a glowing blue LED ring. The charger stands elegantly against a backdrop of blurred mountain scenery. Premium industrial design, smooth surfaces, warm afternoon sunlight catching the edges. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution, no logos or text.
shots.motion: The blue LED ring pulses gently with light as the camera slowly pushes in towards the charging station.

shots.kf: Medium shot of the sleek generic silver electric vehicle parked neatly next to the minimalist matte-black charging station. A thick black cable connects the charger to the car. Golden hour light illuminating the mountain landscape in the background. Cinematic composition, serene atmosphere, photorealistic, no visible brand markings.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pans horizontally from left to right, revealing the connection between the car and the glowing charger.

shots.kf: Medium shot of two anonymous human silhouettes standing at a scenic mountain viewpoint near a modern wooden railing, holding generic coffee cups. Sun setting behind the distant peaks, casting a warm orange glow over the landscape. Relaxed atmosphere, cinematic lighting, photorealistic, out of focus car in the deep background.
shots.motion: The silhouettes stand still, enjoying the view, while the camera slowly dollies backward to reveal more of the sunset.

shots.kf: Cinematic wide shot from behind of the sleek generic silver electric vehicle driving away into a spectacular orange and purple sunset on a straight mountain highway. Long shadows on the asphalt, majestic mountains in the distance. Premium aesthetic, dynamic composition, photorealistic, no text or signage.
shots.motion: The car drives away smoothly towards the horizon as the camera slowly booms up to capture the vast sunset sky.

films.desc_en: A cozy, lifestyle-driven commercial demonstrating the comfort and ease of smart home heat pumps during a cold Skopje winter.
films.music: Warm acoustic guitar with soft piano chords, 85 bpm
vo_mk: Но вашиот дом нека биде топол.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a woman in her mid-30s with a short brown bob haircut, wearing a thick beige knitted sweater. She is looking out of a large frost-covered window at a snowy residential street in Skopje. Cool winter light coming from outside contrasts with the warm room interior. Photorealistic, soft cinematic lighting.
shots.motion: The woman turns her head slowly away from the window towards the warm interior of the room.

shots.kf: Close-up of the same woman in her mid-30s with a short brown bob and thick beige sweater. She is standing next to a sleek, generic wall-mounted smart thermostat with a glowing orange ambient display. The background is a softly lit modern living room. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field, no readable text.
shots.motion: The woman simply stands smiling at the thermostat while the camera slowly pushes in for an intimate close-up.

shots.kf: Medium wide shot of a modern, minimalist grey heat pump unit installed against the exterior brick wall of a contemporary home. Snow is falling gently around it. The unit looks premium and high-tech, with no brand names. Cold blue winter lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed exterior architectural photography.
shots.motion: The large circular fan of the heat pump spins continuously and smoothly while snow falls softly in the foreground.

shots.kf: Wide shot of the same woman in her mid-30s with a short brown bob and thick beige sweater, relaxing comfortably on a plush grey sofa. She is holding a generic hardback book. The living room is bathed in warm, inviting amber light from a floor lamp. Cozy, premium lifestyle aesthetic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman relaxes on the sofa, breathing gently, as the camera slowly pans across the cozy living room.

shots.kf: Medium close-up of the woman in her mid-30s with a short brown bob and thick beige sweater, looking directly at the camera with a warm, satisfied smile. The background is beautifully blurred with soft warm bokeh lights from the cozy living room. Photorealistic, cinematic portrait, flattering soft lighting.
shots.motion: The woman smiles warmly and blinks naturally while the camera remains completely still, creating a strong emotional connection.

films.desc_en: A fast-paced, visually striking vertical video for social media promoting quick adoption of residential solar panels.
films.music: Punchy modern electronic bass house, energetic, 128 bpm
vo_mk: Соларна енергија за вашиот дом денес.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. Drone shot looking straight down at the dark tiled roof of a modern suburban house in Skopje. The roof is half-covered in sleek, black, highly reflective generic solar panels. Bright midday sunlight reflects off the glass surfaces. High contrast, vivid colors, photorealistic, 8k resolution.
shots.motion: The drone camera slowly descends vertically towards the solar panels, increasing the reflection of the sun.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. Extreme macro close-up of the smooth, dark blue grid texture of a modern solar panel. A brilliant sun flare hits the very edge of the frame, washing the dark cells in warm golden light. Sleek industrial design, highly detailed, photorealistic, abstract and premium energy aesthetic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pans diagonally across the textured surface of the solar panel as the sunlight shifts.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. A brightly lit, ultra-modern living room centered in the frame. Large floor-to-ceiling windows let in massive amounts of natural daylight, illuminating sleek modern furniture and a glowing modern standing lamp. The atmosphere is vibrant, airy, and clean. Photorealistic, architectural digest style, perfectly symmetrical.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pushes forward into the center of the bright living room, emphasizing the clean energy lifestyle.

films.desc_en: A single, coherent electron-to-outlet story set in Skopje: dawn on the Vardar quay, then a quiet kitchen in an older Skopje apartment. One recurring hero (same outfit throughout) carries one object—a small solar panel—linking generation to everyday use. Same kitchen, same angle for before/after; only the light changes, ending bright and readable.
films.music: Modern Balkan-ambient pulse, warm synth pad with subtle tapan-like low hits, 96 bpm
vo_mk: Секое утро почнува со едно мало сонце.
Енергијата патува: од производство до мрежа.
Стабилно се води низ градот, без застој.
И стигнува дома — кога најмногу треба.

shots.kf: Dawn on the Vardar quay in Skopje, quiet riverbank with stone steps and leafless trees, no readable signage anywhere. A single woman in her early 30s, dark hair tied back, wearing a beige jacket and charcoal jeans, holds a small portable solar panel like a briefcase. Medium-wide, 35mm lens, soft pink-blue sunrise, natural color palette, photorealistic, simple clear face and hands.
shots.motion: She tilts the small solar panel toward the rising sun; camera makes a slow, steady dolly-in from waist-up to tighter chest framing, keeping the river softly blurred behind her.

shots.kf: Same Vardar quay, closer view: her hands connect a short black cable from the small solar panel into a compact matte-black power box with a single glowing white indicator dot (no logos). Tight close-up, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; warm rim light from sunrise, cool river reflections. Concrete texture and damp stone visible; no text, no signs, photorealistic, hands clean and unambiguous.
shots.motion: She clicks the connector into place with a firm push; camera performs a gentle lateral slide left-to-right across her hands, maintaining focus on the connector and indicator dot.

shots.kf: Cut to a Skopje residential side street near the Old Bazaar area, but framed signage-free: tangled overhead utility lines, old plaster walls, balconies, parked cars out of focus. The same woman walks into frame carrying the same small solar panel and power box. Medium shot, 35mm lens, late morning neutral daylight, muted Balkan tones (sand, gray, olive). Photorealistic street textures; no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She walks past camera left-to-right, glancing up at the overhead lines; camera pans smoothly to follow her movement, ending on the cables stretching toward the distance.

shots.kf: Interior, older Skopje apartment kitchen, modest and real: pale mint tiles, wooden table, small kettle, same props positioned consistently. It is overcast daylight through a window; the room feels slightly dim. The same woman places the compact power box on the table beside the kettle, cable neatly looped. Static medium-wide, 28mm lens, soft natural light, restrained warm-cool palette, photorealistic, no brands or text visible.
shots.motion: She sets the power box down and flips one small rocker switch; camera makes a slow push-in of about 30 cm toward the table, keeping her hands and the switch centered.

shots.kf: end_kf: Same kitchen, identical camera position and framing as the previous shot. The only change: warm practical light turns on above the table, making the mint tiles and wood grain feel alive and welcoming; the indicator dot on the power box remains softly lit. The woman relaxes her shoulders, looking at the now-brighter room. Photorealistic, clean faces/hands, no readable text, bright end frame.
shots.motion: The overhead light snaps on and holds steady; camera remains locked off with a subtle micro-breath (minimal stabilization drift) as she exhales and gives a small satisfied nod.

films.desc_en: An emotional, visually poetic brand film connecting Macedonia's natural elements to the bright, sustainable future of energy.
films.music: Sweeping orchestral strings with subtle modern electronic pulses, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Енергијата е живот, скриена во природата.
Ние ја претвораме во светла иднина.

shots.kf: Cinematic wide shot of powerful, crystal-clear water flowing rapidly through the rocky Matka canyon in North Macedonia. Lush green vegetation clings to the dramatic limestone cliffs. Soft, diffused morning sunlight filters through the mist rising from the river. Photorealistic, nature documentary style, anamorphic lens.
shots.motion: The water rushes continuously downstream while the camera slowly glides forward just above the river surface.

shots.kf: Wide epic shot of three massive, sleek white wind turbines standing on a rolling green hill in Bogdanci, North Macedonia. The sky behind them is filled with dramatic, volumetric white clouds against a deep blue sky. Golden hour lighting casts long shadows on the grass. Photorealistic, majestic.
shots.motion: The massive blades of the wind turbines spin slowly and gracefully in the wind as the camera pans left.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a beautiful, modern eco-friendly home exterior at sunset. The large glass windows reflect the orange and magenta sky. Warm golden light spills from the interior onto a wooden deck. Peaceful, premium lifestyle setting, harmonious with nature. Photorealistic, architectural photography style.
shots.motion: The camera slowly booms down, framing the glowing modern home against the vibrant sunset sky.

shots.kf: Cinematic wide shot from behind showing the dark silhouettes of a father and a young child standing together on a hill at night, looking down at the sprawling, glittering city lights of Skopje in the valley below. A starry night sky above. Emotional, magical atmosphere, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The silhouettes stand perfectly still, observing the view, while the camera slowly pushes in towards them.

shots.kf: Extreme macro shot of a vintage incandescent lightbulb filament glowing warmly in a dark room. The intricate glowing wire is sharply in focus, surrounded by dark, moody shadows. Cinematic lighting, rich amber tones, photorealistic, rich contrast.
shots.end_kf: Extreme macro shot of a modern, sleek LED node glowing with a clean, brilliant white-blue light. The design is highly futuristic and geometric, surrounded by dark space. Crisp, sharp focus, premium high-tech aesthetic.
shots.motion: The glowing vintage filament seamlessly transforms into the bright, modern LED node while the camera maintains a steady close-up.

shots.kf: Epic wide drone shot of the city of Skopje at night, fully illuminated. The city grid glows with millions of golden and white lights, showing a thriving, energetic metropolis. The Vardar river reflects the city lights. Clear night sky, photorealistic, highly detailed urban night photography.
shots.motion: The drone slowly flies forward and slightly upwards, revealing the vast, glowing expanse of the energetic city.
